items.t: Joby Aviation Jumps 9% as Air Taxi Stocks Defy Tech Selloff; Archer Aviation Rallies 7%, EHang Rises 6%
items.sum: While big tech sinks the market, beaten-down eVTOL names are mounting a sharp comeback. But after repeated bounces and fades, can Joby, Archer and EHang hold their gains once the rest of the market recovers?

items.t: Joby Aviation Drops 7%, Archer Aviation Slides 6% as Air Taxi Stocks Give Back Monday’s Rebound; EHang Falls 5% Ahead of Earnings
items.sum: Three air taxi stocks are bleeding after a brief rally, and one of them still hasn't told investors what its year looks like. Why an upcoming earnings report in China could reset expectations for Joby, Archer, and the whole sector.
